ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white vs 55% low-intensity black/grey across visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe: Large contiguous white central blob with heavy black mottling along the lower and lateral margins. Left lobe: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with thin, high-intensity linear vertical streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations along the right lobe trailing edge; distal tips of both lobes exhibit extreme irregular topography due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a strong convex trailing edge curve; left lobe exhibits a linear-to-concave trajectory due to perspective foreshortening.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, raised circular pixel groups (barnacles) on both distal tips; small circular white scars located in the medial-right region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation of the right lobe; several thin vertical high-contrast scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on fluke tips; significant parallel rake marks across the ventral right lobe surface consistent with external trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ocellus' or eye-like marker (black ring with a white center) located in the upper-medial quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
